company_name: British American Tobacco Industries p.l.c. Common Stock
title: Omni™ 2026 Edition – Forward Thinking for a Smokeless World
summary: The 2026 edition of the Omni™ features new insights on science, innovation and the policies shaping Tobacco Harm Reduction.
body_markdown:
Updated with new chapters covering science, innovation, regulation and product stewardship, the latest edition reflects developments across our scientific research, product portfolio and regulatory engagement activities.


The Omni™ is intended to be a compendium of information that underpins our corporate and scientific strategy and offers insights into the work being completed at BAT to create A Better Tomorrow™.


Across ten chapters, it addresses the Big Questions facing us, provides an overview of the science supporting our Smokeless Products, and offers a summary of the global Tobacco Harm Reduction evidence base created over the last decade.
